Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Bull, Kevin <kbull@freepress.com>
Sent: Thursday, December 31, 2015 5:52 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: RE: Hotel rooms 
 
No, you can’t use that 3237 card for hotel charges. It is for Travelocity plane reservations only. When you use it for hotel, it sends a report back to Gannett so then corporate has to track it down. Gannett and Travelocity have an agreement in place for notifications. This is causing problems. Please stop now, OK?

From: Fenech, Anthony 
Sent: Tuesday, December 29, 2015 3:04 PM
To: Bull, Kevin <kbull@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Hotel rooms
I always pay for the hotel bills on my own so I didn't think it was any different. I just don't expense the ones that I'm not doing for work...

From: Bull, Kevin
Sent: Tuesday, December 29, 2015 2:55 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: Hotel rooms

You should not be paying for hotel rooms with the purchasing card. Please just reserve the room with the card but you cannot pay for it on the card. Hotel charges need to be placed on an expense account.  Currently there are 5 hotel bills totaling $2,431.38 that US BANK has not paid since they could not identify who, what, where they should be charged. They were able to track it down to you by calling all the Hiltons. This has been a long standing policy. Got it?
